import time
import board
import busio
import digitalio

print("CP_TFT_BOOT")

spi = busio.SPI(clock=board.GP18, MOSI=board.GP19, MISO=board.GP16)
cs = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.GP17)
dc = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.GP20)
rst = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.GP21)

for pin in (cs, dc, rst):
    pin.direction = digitalio.Direction.OUTPUT

cs.value = True
dc.value = True
rst.value = True

def wait_spi_lock(timeout_s=0.35):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
    while not spi.try_lock():
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            return False
    return True

spi_locked = wait_spi_lock()
if spi_locked:
    spi.configure(baudrate=4000000, polarity=0, phase=0)
else:
    print("CP_TFT_SPI_LOCK_TIMEOUT")

def spi_write(payload, is_data):
    if not spi_locked:
        return False
    dc.value = bool(is_data)
    cs.value = False
    try:
        spi.write(bytes(payload))
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        print("CP_TFT_SPI_ERR", exc)
        return False
    finally:
        cs.value = True

def tft_cmd(cmd):
    return spi_write((cmd & 0xFF,), False)

def tft_data(payload):
    return spi_write(payload, True)

def tft_init():
    rst.value = False
    time.sleep(0.02)
    rst.value = True
    time.sleep(0.12)

    ok = tft_cmd(0x01)
    time.sleep(0.15)
    ok = tft_cmd(0x11) and ok
    time.sleep(0.12)
    ok = tft_cmd(0x3A) and ok
    ok = tft_data((0x55,)) and ok
    ok = tft_cmd(0x29) and ok
    time.sleep(0.02)
    return ok

init_ok = tft_init()
print("CP_TFT_INIT", 1 if init_ok else 0)
print("CP_TFT_STEP", 0, "OK", 1 if init_ok else 0, "COLOR", 0x07E0)
print("CP_TFT_DONE")
